t.hero_alt: Animated Jesus holding a phone with Catholic Trivia
t.about_title: A game designed to help you learn the faith every day from your phone
t.about_text: Catholic Trivia brings together questions on Sacred Scripture, the saints, the sacraments, the liturgy and the life of the Church in clear, peaceful rounds. Every answer leaves you with a short lesson backed by the Bible and the Catechism, so you can play a few minutes a day, on your own or with your family.
t.about1_d: Move up level by level, earn stars and keep your streak alive.
t.about2_d: Every answer includes an explanation and a reference to the Bible or the CCC.
t.about3_d: Prayer banners, parish initiatives and news from the Catholic world.
t.feat_title: Four pillars to learn and enjoy every round
t.f1_d: A daily challenge of 10 varied questions plus level-based paths to keep your streak going, earn stars and review each topic step by step.
t.f2_d: A weekly community leaderboard where you earn XP for correct answers and consecutive days, with your progress saved through Google or Apple.
t.f3_d: Every answer instantly shows clear feedback with its doctrinal teaching and the exact reference to the Bible or the Catechism of the Catholic Church.
t.f4_d: News from the Church via Vatican News and other Catholic outlets, with a link to read each story and its own mini-quiz to play.
t.cats_title: Pick a topic, work through its levels and discover much more
t.cats_desc: Start with the great pillars of the faith and keep adding new topics as the game library grows.
t.plans_title: New questions and news added all the time
t.plans_desc: The app is constantly refreshed: we add new doctrinal questions, topics and Catholic news with their quizzes, so there's always something new to play.
t.live_t: A living library inside the app
t.live_d: New rounds, daily challenges and news from Vatican News and other outlets arrive on your phone automatically.
t.free_sub: Everything you need to play every day and keep learning.
t.free_l1: Daily challenge of 10 questions and a daily streak.
t.free_l2: Levels 1 and 2 in the main categories.
t.free_l3: Catholic news with a daily mini-quiz.
t.free_l4: Explanations with Bible and Catechism references for every question.
t.free_l5: 3 lives that refill automatically every 30 minutes, plus the weekly leaderboard.
t.free_foot: Available for free on the App Store and Google Play.
t.pro_sub: Support the project and unlock all the content with no limit on lives.
t.pro_l1: Unlimited lives to play and learn without waiting for refills.
t.pro_l2: All advanced levels and new topics unlocked.
t.pro_l3: Streak protector to keep your days even if you miss one.
t.pro_l4: You support the ongoing addition of new questions, categories and news.
t.pro_foot: Subscription managed securely through the App Store or Google Play.
